claim: Patchline supports a federated benchmark split for private adopters: local benchmark cases are evaluated with the normal artifact runner, the public result contains only signed aggregate metrics with k-anonymous buckets, and verification rejects both metric tampering and accidental case-level metadata leakage. The gate builds a real temporary benchmark, runs the artifact-benchmark federated-split, federated-run, and federated-verify commands, proves the aggregate is signed, confirms private case identifiers, fixtures, and ground-truth paths are absent from the public JSON, and checks that malformed public aggregates fail, so the workflow is reproducible via `make federated-benchmark-split-gate`.
